RHOAI conventions under test

  • The current navigation item uses the PatternFly current-state class.
  • The page-level Create action is text-only, with no leading plus icon.
  • Page chrome, layout, card, navigation, and button use PatternFly classes.

The separate stylesheet, embedded rule, and inline margin are intentional custom-CSS violations.
